properties.name: camel.dataformat.protobuf.content-type-format
properties.description: Defines a content type format in which protobuf message will be serialized/deserialized from(to) the Java been. The format can either be native or json for either native protobuf or json fields representation.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.protobuf.content-type-header
properties.description: Whether the data format should set the Content-Type header with the type from the data format. For example application/xml for data formats marshalling to XML, or application/json for data formats marshalling to JSON

properties.name: camel.dataformat.protobuf.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the protobuf data format. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.protobuf.instance-class
properties.description: Name of class to use when unmarshalling.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.protobuf.message-name
properties.description: The message type of the schema to use, such as Order, shop.Order or the nested Order.Line. By default the first message type of the schema.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.protobuf.schema
properties.description: The protobuf schema, the text of a .proto file, used instead of instanceClass with the GoogleProtobuf library: messages are read into and written from a com.google.protobuf.DynamicMessage, so no class generated by protoc is needed. It may refer to a resource, such as classpath:order.proto, file:order.proto or an http URL. This needs camel-protobuf-schema on the classpath.
